legacyArchive.note: Do not copy or execute historical legacy migrations unless the project owner explicitly reintroduces and approves their provenance and application history.

migrationRunnerPolicy.requiredExpectedDatabaseName: RIDEX_EXPECTED_DATABASE_NAME must exactly match the database name encoded in DATABASE_URL_TEST

migrationSafetyRules: Never execute migrations during static implementation steps.
Before final-phase migration tests, verify the exact local TEST database identity and take a checksum-verified backup.
Use only the active Prisma migrations directory for migrate deploy; fresh_baseline is a reference/consistency copy, not a second migration directory.
Do not automatically repair or mark migrations applied if the database migration history disagrees with the files.
On failed migration, stop and preserve the migration error/context; do not manually edit _prisma_migrations or rerun destructive steps without a reviewed recovery plan.
No migration rollback is assumed; use an approved forward-fix or a separately reviewed restore plan.
Compare Prisma schema, active migration history, constraints, indexes and enum values against a fresh empty local TEST database and an approved prior-version fixture during final testing.
finalPhysicalTests: Verify database identity and ensure it is dedicated to this fresh project before connecting.
Run prisma migrate status against an isolated empty local TEST database.
Run prisma migrate deploy on a disposable empty local TEST database and capture applied migration IDs/checksums.
Run an approved upgrade path from a sanitized prior-version fixture and compare schema drift.
Test migration failure/interrupt handling without editing Prisma history manually.
Verify critical unique constraints, indexes, foreign keys, monetary precision and enum values after migration.
Take a checksum-verified backup before migration and verify the approved restore/forward-fix path.

migrationReview.note: Source observation only. Inventory and SHA-256 values do not approve migration order or prove the chain applies to an existing database. Runtime migrate status/deploy and schema comparison remain deferred until explicit final TEST-database approval.
